subject: TURN directive
notes: cite.py --check 7.3.25.3 'Exception-name-1 shall be one of the exception names listed in 14.6.13.1' OK. SR2 is a syntax rule of the directive, asked by the directive stage (TurnDirectiveProcessor.ParseTurn) for a compiled line and an omitted-branch line (7.2.1, CheckOperand) alike, through ExceptionNameRule, the one rule the binder's written-name funnel also asks (kb/Work PB2740): COBOL0711 for a non-catalog name, located at the directive's line; EC-USER- and the implementor's EC-IMP- names accepted; the per-name edition window COBOL0878 (2023-only families at --std 2002/2014). TurnState.Build folds only resolved names and throws on an unresolved one (a broken hand-off). Second sentence: nothing verifies that a named exception or file-name is used in the range, and no such check exists (correct).
